model: written by Claude Code in a session, 1 Nov 2026
paragraphs: The official rate for a dollar in Turkey rose 10.4449% between 15 Nov and 18 Nov 2021. The street price rose 12.978% between 11 Nov and 18 Nov, and was already up 3.1439% on 12 Nov.
Turkey's central bank cut interest rates on 18 Nov 2021 [1]. The lira fell to a record low the same day [1].

sources.title: Turkey's central bank cuts rates again, lira sinks to record low
